name: Diana
source:
Being the most stunning member of the literature club, some people think she is there just to her herself and avoid unwanted attention. But that is not true, her passion to literature started during her childhood, which was filled with stories told by her grandmother. She spends her evenings at the club, as everyone there only cares about books, not appearances.
